A rugged, weathered individual appearing in his late 30s with a square jaw and a gruff expression. The hair is a short, cropped buzz cut of salt-and-pepper grey. The eyes are narrow, sharp, and steel grey. The build is broad-shouldered and muscular, wearing a charcoal grey duster coat over a white shirt with a wide-brimmed brown hat.
BODY COLOR: tanned skin
